newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR steady as banks catious.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR steady as banks catious.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were stuck at the previous day's levels as banks took a cautious stance ahead of next week's tax payments and 10-year bond auction, traders said.
The tax remittances and the bond auction are projected to mop up 15 to 20 billion pesos from the system, affecting the spot overnight and Treasury bill rates, one trader said.
"Everybody's in a wait-and-see mode right now. Nobody wants to change the rates before the T-bill auction," he added.
PHIBOR are the average swap rates quoted by 20 banks operating in the country.
